headline: A clearer first visit for every new patient.
subhead: This sample page turns three public facing observations into one focused recommendation for the practice.
context: Jamie, the practice already explains its care philosophy well. The next opportunity is to make the path from first question to booked visit easier to follow on a phone.

observations.title: Strong patient language
observations.detail: The practice description sounds calm and specific, which gives the page a useful voice to build from.

observations.title: Scattered next steps
observations.detail: New patients have several links to choose from before they know which action fits their situation.

observations.title: Mobile trust gap
observations.detail: Hours, insurance guidance, and first visit details can sit closer to the main booking action.

recommendation_title: Build one guided path for new patients.
recommendation_body: Lead with the practice promise, answer the three questions patients ask first, and keep one booking action visible as they scroll. The result is a page the front desk can send after any inquiry.
